# @fyit/crouton-sales

> Event-based POS system for pop-up events, markets, and temporary retail. Includes products, categories, orders, and optional thermal receipt printing.

AI hint: use when app needs point of sale, product catalog, or order management

## Components

- `SalesAdminPosSidebar`: Admin navigation sidebar
- `SalesClientCart`: Shopping cart with quantity controls
- `SalesClientCartTotal`: Order total with item count
- `SalesClientCategoryTabs`: Category navigation tabs
- `SalesClientOfflineBanner`: Offline mode indicator
- `SalesClientOrderInterface`: Main customer-facing order page
- `SalesClientProductList`: Product grid with inline options
- `SalesClientProductOptionsSelect`: Product variant/option selection
- `SalesClientSelector`: Client selector with create-on-type
- `SalesPosOrdersList`: Orders table with status filtering
- `SalesSettingsPrintPreviewModal`: Receipt preview with test print
- `SalesSettingsReceiptSettingsModal`: Receipt text customization modal

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useHelperAuth`
- `usePosOrder`
